en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(The narrator) says, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying:
‘The Penalty (Hadd) of the whipping (is applied) in the adultery if you find two to be in one quilt, and the two men both found to be in one quilt, and the two women both found to be in one quilt’.
